scope: One-off day-use onsen coverage gap fill across the existing 47 prefectures; data-only category assignment. PR only.

methodology.baseline: category_id hot-spring-pool OR 温泉|onsen|日帰り|sento|銭湯 in name/description/tags/things_to_do/unique_selling_point; includes incidental keyword matches, not a count of confirmed bathhouses.
methodology.candidate_horizon: Two family-portal pages per prefecture, first five in-prefecture non-advertisement facility cards per page; plus all 43 domestic Gokurakuyu roster entries, 18 Hakone day-bath entries and independently confirmed ADDs. Cross-source repeats merged. Other rosters are discovery-source checks, not exhaustive facility audits.
methodology.listing_entries_reviewed_definition: Conservative count of baseline rows examined plus candidate listing assessments; cross-source repeated observations and background roster entries are not added again.
methodology.holds: HOLD(other) includes confirmations not completed in this bounded traversal. It does not assert the information is unavailable or the facility is ineligible. Required field gaps, official fetch errors, lodging day-use uncertainty and coordinate verification gaps are recorded per candidate.
methodology.coverage_not_applicable: This label records the specific unsuccessful coverage attempt, not successful coverage and not a claim that the source type does not exist in that prefecture.
methodology.duplicate_check: NFKC/spacing/punctuation normalization, prefecture, address and official URL; branch names and separate facilities at shared complexes reviewed.
